title: Let's Learn English Lesson 49
subtitle: Operation Spy!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English \u2013 Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 49: Operation Spy! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is no secret that Washington, D.C. has spies. Well, it should be a secret because spying is secret. But it’s not a secret. There’s even a spy museum! The International Spy Museum has created an amazing collection of spy things! And today, we will see them! My boss, Ms. Weaver, has sent me here … on a mission!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有间谍，这不是秘密。嗯，这本该是秘密，因为间谍活动是秘密的。可它不是秘密。这儿甚至有一座间谍博物馆！国际间谍博物馆收藏了很多了不起的间谍物品！今天我们就去看！我的老板韦弗女士派我来这儿……执行任务！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna, are you there?
dialogue.zh: 喂，安娜，你在吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s her. Yes, Agent Peacock. This is Agent Flamingo, reporting for duty.
dialogue.zh: 是她。是的，孔雀特工。我是火烈鸟特工，报到。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Agent what? Look, Anna … I mean, Agent Flamingo, I want you to learn all you can about spying.
dialogue.zh: 什么特工？听着，安娜……我是说，火烈鸟特工，我要你尽量多了解间谍活动。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You mean, collect intelligence?
dialogue.zh: 你是说，收集情报？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yeah, it’s for our new show -- “D.C. Secrets.”
dialogue.zh: 对，是给我们的新节目——《特区秘密》。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You've got it, Agent Peacock. The mission is safe with me.
dialogue.zh: 明白，孔雀特工。任务包在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Oh, okay, great. Just be back by noon.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好，很好。中午之前回来就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Agent Peacock, I’m at an air duct!
dialogue.zh: 孔雀特工，我到通风管了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, spies sometimes sneak down air ducts.
dialogue.zh: 是的，间谍有时会从通风管悄悄爬下去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have never snuck down an air duct. It’s dark and small. I’m afraid of dark, small places.
dialogue.zh: 我从没从通风管爬下去过。又黑又小。我怕又黑又小的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You can do it, Agent Flamingo. You know, spies aren’t afraid of a little darkness.
dialogue.zh: 你能行的，火烈鸟特工。你知道，间谍不怕一点点黑暗。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. It’s just an air duct -- a dark, small air duct. Okay. I’m doing it, Agent Peacock! I am sneaking down a long, dark, small air duct. I’m having a little trouble breathing.
dialogue.zh: 对。只是一根通风管——又黑又小的通风管。好。我在做了，孔雀特工！我正沿着又长又黑又小的通风管往下爬。我呼吸有点困难。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Just keep going, Agent Flamingo. Think of the team!
dialogue.zh: 继续往前，火烈鸟特工。想想团队！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, I will think of the team. I’m thinking of the team, Agent Peacock! I did it! I did it! I sneaked down an air duct. That was a little uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 好，我会想着团队。我在想着团队，孔雀特工！我做到了！我做到了！我从通风管爬下来了。有点不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Good!
dialogue.zh: 好！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What's the next mission?
dialogue.zh: 下一个任务是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Umm … have you ever cracked a code?
dialogue.zh: 嗯……你破译过密码吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Well, go learn. Spies use their brains.
dialogue.zh: 那就去学。间谍靠脑子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it! I’ve never cracked a code before. Let’s try, Agent Flamingo! This is really hard. I'm still trying to crack the code. I've cracked the code! I've cracked the code, Agent Peacock! My brain really hurts.
dialogue.zh: 明白！我以前从没破译过密码。试试吧，火烈鸟特工！这真难。我还在试着破译。我破译了！我破译了，孔雀特工！我的脑子真疼。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Great. Umm, Agent Flamingo, now answer this question: Do spies have to be in good shape?
dialogue.zh: 很好。嗯，火烈鸟特工，现在回答这个问题：间谍必须身体好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: “Yes,” Agent Peacock! Spies have to be in really good shape! Can you hear me?
dialogue.zh: “是的”，孔雀特工！间谍必须身体非常好！你听得见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You’re breaking up, Flamingo.
dialogue.zh: 信号不好，火烈鸟。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The International Spy Museum is awesome! Agent Peacock, I completed the mission!
dialogue.zh: 国际间谍博物馆太棒了！孔雀特工，我完成任务了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Great. Great. Now, I have another very important mission for you.
dialogue.zh: 很好。很好。现在，我还有一个非常重要的任务给你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it. See you back at H.Q.!
dialogue.zh: 明白。总部见！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yummy! You brought my lunch! Thanks, Agent Flamingo!
dialogue.zh: 好吃！你把我的午饭带来了！谢谢，火烈鸟特工！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mission completed. Agent Peacock!
dialogue.zh: 任务完成。孔雀特工！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Don't ask.
dialogue.zh: 别问。

quiz.prompt: What is Ms. Weaver's last mission for Anna?
